summary: Ambev S.A. furnished a 6-K attaching its August 2026 Brazilian CVM Instruction 44/2021 monthly treasury-securities report. The filing shows cancellation of 279,000,000 common shares on August 13 at R$0.00, alongside a Santander-brokered purchase of 3,517,700 common shares on August 3 at R$15.8598, totaling R$55.79 million. Treasury holdings fell from 343,666,335 to 68,178,365 common shares. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, price-per-share deal terms, or regulatory clock is stated. Watch for whether the share cancellation signals a broader capital-return program and any follow-on buyback disclosure.
